scope: Finite simulation of the memory-backed frame-metadata and row-source producer. The integrated compactor, shared store and full-frame handoff are outside this test.

implementation.metadata_validation: Checks root, dense rank, original position, layer, epoch, raw exponent, physical epsilon and reserved bits before configuring the row normalizer.
implementation.storage: One metadata packet plus the existing strip reader and output skid; no raw-frame tensor buffer.
implementation.fault_handling: Retains offered transfers under backpressure, drains owned reads, quarantines ambiguous responses and preserves frame fault status through retirement.

simulation.coverage: Consecutive healthy rows; metadata identity, exponent, epsilon and burst errors; unsolicited responses; held transfers, aborts, coupled resets and post-reset reuse.
simulation.test_data: Authenticated layer0 image input, learned gains and row metadata remain in project .cache. The testbench requires +FRAME_SOURCE_INPUT_ROOT, +FRAME_SOURCE_JOURNAL and +FRAME_SOURCE_CATALOG_SHA; input fixtures and journal are not included in Git.

verification.receipt_correction: Original run receipt used descriptive text instead of the missing-state enum. A disclosed sibling corrected only that field and explanatory metadata; original tool results, command, sources and numerical results were preserved.

limitations.technology: The project targets a Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company 28-nanometer adaptation. This component simulation makes no silicon area, timing or energy claim.
